hypothesis: At 0.10 s after first head/right-foot contact, failed trajectories request less right hip pitch and more right knee angle relative to their actual pose. Test the opposite, coordinated target correction before pitch rotation stalls. The previous late two-knee pulse is closed.

mechanism.target_rule: Change only these processed targets. Apply the pulse only when both original destinations are legal, and clip corrections to the existing legal range. Raw policy output and action history stay unchanged.

gate: At least eight aligned triggered worlds with actual changed targets. Median tilt gain of at least 5 degrees versus the better official repeat at contact + 0.50 s. At least two aligned triggered worlds pass timely and final hold when both references fail, and zero losses among worlds both references pass. Compare all original scores and keep every outcome.
